cancellation: Synchronous value/policy operations; controller scheduling/cancellation remains separate required lifecycle work.
conformance_cases: verification/agones/sdk-version-witnesses.json plus normal-Cargo invalidation/compiled Go overrides and configured/default admission/Pod consumers.
consistency: Local deterministic field assignment. No resource version/conditional-write/retry protocol is introduced by this feature.
errors: Build I/O/configuration failures fail the Cargo build. Admission malformed-input fallthrough and actual builder hook errors retain existing production paths.
idempotency: Repeated SDK assignment of the same identity is idempotent. Other source defaulting effects, including repeated finalizer append, retain their existing semantics and are not relabeled idempotent.
input_types: Canonical GameServer/Fleet metadata and Rusternetes Pod construction inputs
ordering: Build input is frozen by Cargo; mutations invoke the shared CGP annotation provider without reading process environment. Pod stamping occurs before mutate_game_server_pod/set_eviction.
output_observation: Decoded JSON SDK annotation value, with original raw bytes retained in the CGP build identity.
ownership: One raw AgonesBuildVersion owner per composed context; compiled annotation constants are derived observations. Owned metadata is mutated; Pod builder borrows the parent.
postconditions: Unconfigured identity is source dev; explicit empty/custom/raw values are preserved.
Exactly one U+FFFD replaces each invalid UTF-8 byte in the decoded JSON annotation; valid UTF-8 is unchanged.
GameServer/Fleet/default Pod paths overwrite prior SDK annotations with the selected version.
Other annotation keys are preserved; Pod construction does not mutate parent/template metadata.
Version stamping precedes product hooks. A product hook may replace the Pod SDK annotation, and that result is retained.
preconditions: Current evidence host is Linux x86_64 with the pinned Rust/Go tools.
A composed getter supplies one immutable build identity during each operation.
residual_required: Full cloud-product hook conformance, including any source parent-spec mutation, remains required boundary work.
Command logging, command sidecar image defaults, full packaging/build lifecycle, live cluster conformance and all other baseline behavior remain required.
No ordinary check or this profile is a formal source-assertion/refinement proof.
trusted_boundaries: Cargo/Rust code generation and configured environment handling
